blocks.text: **X01 — Assisted Balance / Stretch (Expanded)**
08:41 AM. Normal set khatam hone ke baad Taniya ne resistance band side pe rakha aur Vivek ki taraf dekha.
**Taniya:** “Ek standing balance try karte hain? Aaj main hold karna chahti hoon.”
Vivek ne sir hilaya.
**Vivek:** “Position batao.”
Taniya ne mat ke centre pe khadi hokar ek leg thoda aage rakha, doosra back. Usne dono haath Vivek ke shoulders pe rakhe, fingers lightly gripping the fabric of his shirt.
**Taniya:** “Yahan. Balance ke liye.”

Vivek ne uske upper back aur shoulder-blade area pe apne haath rakhe — firm, professional, lekin close. Uske palms uske plum tank ke fabric ke through warm the. Taniya ne weight shift kiya. Uske black leggings tight the, midriff open, core engaged. Vivek ka support uske shoulder blades pe steady tha.
Six seconds. Taniya ne nazar uske face pe rakhi.
**Taniya:** “Itna close coaching pehle nahi dete the.”
Vivek ki awaaz low thi.
**Vivek:** “Aaj tumne request ki hai.”
Usne haath nahi hataye. Taniya ne ek chhoti saans li, phir bola,
**Taniya:** “Ek baar aur. Same position.”

Vivek ne support maintain kiya. Is baar Taniya ne thoda aur lean kiya, uske shoulders pe grip thodi tight hui. Uske plum tank ka hem uske midriff pe move hua. Vivek ke haath shoulder blades pe the, thumbs lightly pressing. Koi extra move nahi hua. Hold complete hote hi Taniya ne pehle haath hataye, seedha khadi hui, aur uski taraf dekha.

blocks.alt: Original author's Episode 04B Taniya gym illustration

blocks.text: **Taniya:** “Better. Aaj form control mere paas tha.”
Vivek ne haath side pe kiye. Uske expression mein koi open reaction nahi tha, lekin usne nazar uske face se jaldi nahi hatayi.

blocks.alt: Original author's Episode 04B Taniya gym illustration

blocks.text: 08:44 AM. Assisted hold khatam hote hi Taniya ne pehle apne haath Vivek ke shoulders se hataye. Woh seedhi khadi hui, shoulders back, chin thoda up. Deep-plum cropped tank uske midriff pe settled tha, black high-waisted leggings tight. Usne ek chhoti saans li aur mirror ki taraf nahi dekha — seedha Vivek ki taraf.
Taniya:
“Aaj correction mere request pe hua. Pehle aap khud decide karte the.”
Vivek ne haath side pe kiye. Uske shirt pe abhi bhi uske grip ka halka impression tha.
Vivek:
“Aaj tumne clearly bola.”

Taniya ne resistance band uthaya aur fold kiya. Uske movements deliberate the — no rush, no looking away. Woh mat ke edge pe khadi rahi, one hand on her hip, the other holding the band. Midriff open, posture controlled.
Taniya:
“Phir next time bhi poochh ke karna. Form control ab shared hai.”

Vivek ne sir hilaya. Koi extra step nahi badhaya. Taniya ne gym bag uthaya, bottle side pocket mein daali, aur exit ki taraf mudi. Uske walk mein pehle se zyada steadiness thi. Door ke paas ruk kar usne peeche dekha.
Taniya:
“Kal same time. Agar main na aayi toh mat assume karna main form bhool gayi.”
Vivek ne kuch nahi kaha, bas dekha. Taniya gym se bahar nikal gayi.
Vivek ne sir hilaya. Koi extra step nahi badhaya.
Taniya ne gym bag uthane se pehle ruk kar uski taraf dekha.
Taniya:
“Ek last balance? Short. Phir main chali jaungi.”
Vivek ne mat ki taraf ishara kiya.
Vivek:
“Position le lo.”

Dono mat ke centre pe wapas aaye. Taniya ne ek leg thoda aage, doosra peeche rakha. Usne dono haath Vivek ke shoulders pe rakhe, fingers lightly gripping his shirt. Vivek ne uske upper back aur shoulder-blade area pe haath set kiye — same support as before, lekin is baar distance thoda kam tha. Footing clear thi, lekin Taniya ne weight thoda zyada forward shift kiya.
Taniya:
“Is baar main lead karungi.”
Vivek ne grip steady rakhi.
Vivek:
“Theek hai.”
**G04.6 — Unexpected accident**
Taniya ne weight thoda aur forward shift kiya. Vivek ke haath uske shoulder blades pe the, lekin uska footing ek second ke liye slip hua. Mat pe grip loose hui.
Dono ka balance ek saath gaya.

Vivek peeche ki taraf gira. Taniya uske saath aage jhuki aur seedha uske abdominal area pe land hui — uske midriff aur lower ribs uske stomach ke against, black leggings uske thighs pe. Plum cropped tank upar sarak gaya, midriff fully open. Uske haath abhi bhi uske shoulders pe the, lekin grip tight ho chuki thi. Vivek peeth ke bal mat pe tha, Taniya uske upar diagonally.
Koi planned move nahi tha. Sirf ek genuine slip.

Vivek ne instinct se usko steady karne ke liye haath upar laaye. Uske palms Taniya ke lower-rib / under-bust area pe aa gaye — plum tank ke fabric ke through, firm grip. Taniya ne turant feel kiya. Uske midriff uske abdominal pe press tha, aur fall ke jolt se uske against clear, unexpected pressure aaya.

Dono ek second ke liye freeze hue. Taniya ki saans tez thi. Vivek ke haath abhi bhi uske under-bust ke paas the. Uske black leggings uske thighs pe tight the, uska weight uske stomach pe. Koi extra movement nahi hua, lekin contact clear tha.
Taniya:
“Vivek…”
Vivek:
“Ruk—main…”
Dono ne ek dusre ki taraf dekha. Awkward pause. Phir Vivek ne haath dheere se hataye.
**G04.8 — Vivek’s joke**
Dono ne alag hote hue footing sambhali. Taniya seedhi khadi hui, plum tank neeche kiya, saans normal ki. Vivek bhi utha, shirt theek ki.
Usne ek chhoti smile ke saath bola,
**Vivek:** “Yeh private training hai, Taniya. Iske liye extra fees aur extra time lagega.”
Taniya ne uski taraf dekha, ek eyebrow uthayi.
**Taniya:** “Extra fees tab jab main form kharab karun. Aaj toh aapne balance khoya. Invoice aapke naam.”
Vivek hansa.
**Vivek:** “Fair.”
Dono ne footing sambhali. Taniya ne plum tank neeche kiya, Vivek ne shirt theek ki. Koi injury nahi thi.
Vivek:
“Yeh private training hai, Taniya. Iske liye extra fees aur extra time lagega.”
Taniya ne uski taraf dekha, ek second ruki, phir bola,
Taniya:
“Private sessions dete ho kya? Seriously.”
Vivek ne thoda surprise hua, phir serious tone mein,
Vivek:
“Detā hoon. Structured. Cardio, squats, glute bridges, core, pelvic-floor awareness. Shaadi se pehle stamina aur control chahiye toh kaam aayega.”
Taniya:
“Accounting wali baat samajh aa rahi hai. Daily return chahiye, one-time bonus nahi.”
Vivek:
“5 se 6 subah. Roz. Kal se start kar sakte hain.”
Taniya:
“Kal Saturday hai. Trial. Agar form control rahe toh continue. Location baad mein fix karenge.”
Vivek ne sir hilaya.
Vivek:
“Theek hai.”
Taniya ne gym bag uthaya, bottle side pocket mein daali. Darwaze ke paas ruk kar usne peeche dekha.
Taniya:
“Kal 5 baje. Late mat hona. Extra fees tab, jab main form kharab karun.”
Woh gym se bahar nikal gayi.
